activation: All replay decisions for both intended cases must be closed and hash-sealed or a source-failure stage explicitly closed before new reference acquisition. Failure-only work cannot report detector metrics. Reference hashes do not enter source selection or replay.
document_order: Open named primary anchors first. Follow official canonical migrations if needed, then named-protocol/original-investigator searches. Count failures/retries/verification reads. A search snippet or secondary catalogue alone cannot establish a positive. Never query notifications or raw detector scores to select sources.
candidate_enumeration: Extract all reported transaction identities from each opened primary artifact in document order, retaining source location and stated role. Deduplicate by chain+hash, retain every role/conflict; do not choose only transactions inside S or receiving alerts. After all bounded documents close, audit candidates in sorted canonical(chain,hash)order.
cap_failure: Every found candidate remains in the candidate table. Beyond audit cap retain UNVERIFIED_DUE_TO_CAP; complete inventory cannot be asserted. Do not extend the cap after seeing coverage or replace difficult candidates.
chain_evidence_order: Reuse already retained exact archive transaction/status/header records and full core-address/hash scans when their provenance and row coverage support the requested fact
If needed, fixed provider https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/transactions/{transaction_hash} for actual execution identity/status; no arbitrary provider switching

If no-core selection absence is not established by complete retained scans, use https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/transactions/{transaction_hash}/logs and its exact next_page_params until terminal page under the cap
provider_evidence: Provider metadata/pagination checked is a declared indexer tier, not raw RPC receipt acquisition, receipt-root authentication or complete canonical chain proof. HTTP/status/schema/pagination failures stay unavailable. Match chain-supported primary attribution, hash, successful status, block number/hash/index and exact timestamp against retained headers when present. Do not invent absent fields.
no_core_assertion: Requires verified execution identity plus complete fixed-window address/hash selection scan or complete terminal all-log bundle showing no core emitter. Absence from observation JSONL alone is insufficient. Labeled but unselected transactions remain outside detector inputs.
primary_label_rule: Successful unauthorized execution explicitly attributed by a direct protocol or original investigator report and corroborated by actual chain identity/status. Report association without sufficient role or contradictory sources remains UNKNOWN. Independent reviewer approves role, applicability, duplicate resolution and inventory completeness before joining.
inventory_completeness: Explicit primary inventory closure or independently justified complete enumeration is required. One report naming one transaction, two agreeing reports, page exhaustion and reaching a cap do not prove an incident has no other executions. Default KNOWN_SUBSET_ONLY.

preconditions: Verify exact run/config/source/selection/input/decision seals for both cases or explicit failed-stage receipts
Seal reference inventory and independent adjudication before joining
Keep reference audit files separate from selected detector input files
postdecision_join.identity: Exact(chain_id,transaction_hash), within fixed case window; no time tolerance, same-block proxy, victim-address matching, grouped-neighbor credit or method-specific label subset.
postdecision_join.full_matrix: Join every declared method/policy/budget cell. Report B5 primary comparison for all three policies and the predeclared sensitivities.
postdecision_join.attribution: Execution hit iff same transaction has notification_emitted=true. Incident hit iff at least one verified execution has an exact hit. Never infer causal detection, prevention or saved loss.
postdecision_join.failure_decomposition: Use sealed selection, method and admission records to assign the first failed stage in denominators.json; preserve all original suppression codes.
postdecision_join.freeze_of_decisions: No replay rerun, method retuning, core expansion or history repair in response to reference results.
